units: <cite ref="Pesachim 42b:15">Pes. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>שואבת את הז׳</he> absorbs the froth of boiling meat.

<cite ref="Mishnah Terumot 10:1">Ter. X, 1</cite> <he>ליטול את הז׳</he> to carry off foul matter; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:11:3">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 41ᶜ</cite> top <he>את שהוא ליטול את הז׳</he> a substance which is used for &c.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 53a:28">Ber. 53ᵃ</cite> <he>שמן … את הז׳</he>; Y. ib. VI, 10ᵈ <he>שמן לז׳</he> oil used for perfuming the hands after the meal, v. <cite ref="G00102"><he>זָהַם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 525:1">Yalk. Lev. 525</cite> <he>דבר של ז׳</he> (ed. Lemb. <cite ref="G00184"><he>זומא</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="G00331"><he>זִיטְמָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:3">Yeb. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>שדי בה ז׳</he> he infected her with sensuality.
<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:3">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>הטיל בה ז׳</he> the serpent infected her (Eve, i.e. the human race) with lasciviousness.
<cite ref="Yevamot 103b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>פסקה זוֹהֲמָתָן</he> their sensual passions ceased (were checked through the influence of religion); a. fr.

senses.gloss: ז׳ דשמשא the sultry air produced by the passage of the sunrays through a cloudy atmosphere.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 28b:16">Yoma 28ᵇ</cite> <he>ז׳ דש׳ וכ׳</he> (Ar. a. Ms. L. <cite ref="G00284"><he>זִיהָא</he></cite>, Ms. O. <cite ref="G00137"><he>זוֹהֲרָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the sultry heat is more intense than that of direct sunlight. [<cite ref="Shabbat 123a">Sabb. 123ᵃ</cite> <he>ז׳ ליסטרון</he>, v. <cite ref="G00190"><he>זוֹמְלִיסְטְרוֹן</he></cite>.]
